_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

decedent_name.label: Decedent Name
decedent_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_name.label: Petitioner Name
petitioner_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

petitioner_interest.label: Petitioner Interest
petitioner_interest.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

testacy_status.label: Testacy Status
testacy_status.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

will_supervised_provisions.label: Will Supervised Provisions
will_supervised_provisions.expects: check only if the statement is true

circumstances.label: Circumstances
circumstances.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

supervision_request.label: Supervision Request
supervision_request.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

special_restrictions_details.label: Special Restrictions Details
special_restrictions_details.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address
attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

court_order.label: Court Order
court_order.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

order_date.label: Order Date
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

judge_name.label: Judge Name
judge_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
